title: Custom `ResourceFormatLoader` and `ResourceFormatSaver` classes can cause GDScript compilation failure with Autoload Singletons
body:
### Tested versions

**Reproducible in all Godot 4 versions**

Explicitly tested in Godot 4.0 and Godot 4.7 RC 1

### System information

Godot v4.7.rc1 - Fedora Linux 44 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (RADV GFX1201) - AMD Ryzen 9 7900X3D 12-Core Processor (24 threads) - 61.90 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

In Godot 4.0, custom classes that inherit from `ResourceFormatLoaders` or `ResourceFormatSavers` are compiled before Autoload Singletons can be registered as global constants with the Language Server. Consequently, any and all classes referenced by the classes inheriting from `ResourceFormatLoaders` or `ResourceFormatSavers` are forcibly compiled at this time. If any of those classes reference an Autoload Singleton by name then the compilation will fail with an "Identifier not found" error.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/eb03ae8fc5465793f8f617d7a320e3b208f16919/main/main.cpp#L4492-L4510

### Steps to reproduce

1. Run project
2. Encounter the following error: `GDScript::reload: Compile Error: Identifier not found: Autoload`
3. Expected behavior is that the word "Autoload" is printed to the console.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[autoload-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28863243/autoload-test.zip)
